newsitem.title: GERMANY: German neo-Nazi jailed for five years for stabbing.
newsitem.headline: German neo-Nazi jailed for five years for stabbing.

text.p: A German schoolboy who described himself as a neo-Nazi was found guilty on Thursday of trying to stab a Turkish woman to death.
The youth, who was not named, was convicted of attempted murder and sentenced to five years in jail. His age was not given.
A court spokesman said the youth called himself a neo-Nazi, although he did not belong to any specific group.
The court in the western city of Essen heard that the attack took place last May at an underground railway station where he jostled the woman and attacked her with a knife, seriously wounding her.
The public and media were barred from the trial as the defendant was a minor.
